newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan FTC files bid-rigging complaint vs 25 firms.
newsitem.headline: Japan FTC files bid-rigging complaint vs 25 firms.

text.p: Japan's Fair Trade Commission said on Tuesday it had filed a complaint with prosecutors against 25 water-gauge makers, including Kimmon Manufacturing Co Ltd and Aichi Tokei Denki Co Ltd, and 34 individual employees of the firms over suspected bid-rigging.
The anti-monopoly watchdog said they are suspected of rigging bids by prearranging winners of contracts for water gauges awarded by the Tokyo metropolitan government between 1994 and 1997.
"We deeply regret it, and we have already conducted an in-house investigation and punished employees involved last November," said a spokesman for Aichi Tokei Denki.

The FTC said this was the first time it had taken such action against suspected bid riggers since 1995, when it accused a number of electronics firms of rigging bids in tenders for a public corporation.
Nine firms were found guilty of the charges at the Tokyo High Court in May 1996.
